note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: Our trading book holds $40 million of corporate bonds with an average duration of 6 years.

answers.common.decision: Whether to hedge the book or reduce it; the head of trading decides.
answers.common.audience: The head of trading and the risk committee.
answers.common.materials: Our risk policy says a rate rise of 1 percentage point must not cost the book more than $2 million. Rates have moved by as much as 2 percentage points in a year.
answers.finance-modeling.purpose: Measure the book's loss from a rise in rates against the limit.
answers.finance-modeling.data: The bond book's positions and durations, in US dollars.
